commercial_rationale: PRODUCT OWNER SETTLED DECISION: MONITOR, required trigger DECISION_CHANGED - correcting the prior VERIFY label (Case Correction Gate, Section 11/Case 7). Unlike every other case, buyer_fit_matches is EMPTY here - there is no positive signal at all, only breadth of ordinary application-stage unknowns (no unit count yet, no development type, application not yet decided). VERIFY requires a specific, named, resolvable, BLOCKING fact; nothing here rises to that - it is ordinary pre-decision incompleteness. The genuine future external trigger is the application being decided (DECISION_CHANGED), which is real, nameable, and external - not an investigate-now question in disguise.
reviewer_notes: Historically calibrated (prior phase) as VERIFY; re-extracted fresh evidence for V1 does not support that label (Section 18 - never assume stale calibration facts still apply). Corrected to MONITOR by Product Owner (2026-09-15).
